title: ACA s. 43D — Duties and functions of Council

content.study:
Section 43D — Duties and functions of Council

Section 43D sets out the Council's duties and functions concerning promotion of arbitration and ADR, professional standards, institutional grading, accreditation-related functions, training and measures to strengthen arbitration infrastructure.

Part IA provisions concerning the Arbitration Council of India must be read with the commencement and implementation status of the relevant provisions and subordinate legislation.

sections.heading: Implementation check
sections.body: Before relying on an institutional provision in litigation or advice, verify whether the relevant Part IA provision has been brought into force and what subordinate legislation or notification applies.

examples.title: Current-law check
examples.body: Identify the statutory provision and verify its commencement/implementation status before treating it as an operative institutional rule.

hypotheticals.question: How should section 43D be approached?
hypotheticals.analysis: State the statutory text, verify commencement status, identify the institutional function and apply only the operative law.

misconceptions.trap: Assuming every Part IA provision is automatically operational merely because it appears in the Act.
misconceptions.correction: Check commencement and implementation status before relying on the institutional provision.
